name: Ur-Fleece
_notes: Transcribed from sheet EU3100 (Lv I-IX), trait cards Mortal Kindling / Just a Memory, AI ER3101-ER3121 + Coming of Darkness, BP ES3123-ES3140, Storybook p.182-183 (Harsh Truth Battle) and p.7-8 rules.
99 Wounds: the Battle is won by escaping the Abyss Track (Argo beyond space 1).
Smother (Storybook p.6) is assumed to be in play because Ur-Fleece cards refer to smothered gear.
White Lie Battle (p.184-185) is a story battle and is not implemented.

traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Race Through Dark Places: Ignore during first Primordial Round. At the start of every Primordial Round, starting with the rightmost Black Abyss tile, move each tile 5 spaces toward the rightmost (highest number) column. Ur-Fleece moves with the Black Abyss tile he is standing on. Any tiles that would cross the Board Edge are removed from the Board. Then, place a new Black Abyss tile on the leftmost spaces of every lane where a Black Abyss tile was removed.
traits.It Spreads: Flicker: Ur-Fleece moves to the furthest spaces of the closest Black Abyss to the left, then turns toward the most Titans. If there is no viable tile to move to, immediately trigger the Race Through Dark Places Trait (as if it was the beginning of the Primordial Round), and then perform Flicker (if able). Triggers when prompted. Black March: Move Ur-Fleece and all the Black Abyss tiles it is currently standing on 5 spaces toward to the right (toward the highest-numbered) column. If this would cause a tile to overlap with another tile, move that other tile 5 spaces toward the right-most column too. If any tile would cross the Board Edge, remove it from the Battle Board and place a new Black Abyss tile on the left-most spaces of the same lane it was removed from. Fade In: Ur-Fleece moves to the furthest spaces of the closest Black Abyss to the right. If there is no tile to fade in to, Ur-Fleece moves off the Battle Board and wins. Full rules: Cycle V Storybook, p. 8.
traits.Always There: For the purposes of all Ur-Fleece Attacks and effects, Ur-Fleece is always considered adjacent to the Titan. The Titan is not considered adjacent to Ur-Fleece. Boundless: The left short Board Edge is Boundless. Ur-Knockback X: Knockback X toward the closest short Board Edge. Considered a Knockback. Ur-Pull X: Pull X toward Ur-Fleece. Ur-Fleece stops the Pull if it would be forced to leave a Black Abyss tile. Considered a Pull.
traits.No Other Gods Before Me: If you die while you are Awakened, permanently remove that Awakening from the game.
traits.Microwave Shield: Before performing an Attack Roll, for each space between you and Ur-Fleece, discard 1 token from the Kratos Pool.
traits.Mortal Kindling: If you have the Light X keyword, during a single movement, you may move through X spaces of a Black Abyss Terrain tile. In this way, you may end your movement on a Black Abyss space. When you move through or onto a Black Abyss tile, gain 1 Ambrosia token at the end of that movement. If a Titan starts its turn on a Black Abyss tile and doesn't move until the end of this turn, they gain 1 Ambrosia token. If at any point you do not have the Light X keyword while on a Black Abyss, you die. Relight: When you deal a Wound, move X Ambrosia tokens from a game element with Light X to your Sheet, where X is the BP level.
traits.Smother: (Cycle V Storybook p.6) When you gain Ambrosia tokens, if possible, place them on game elements with the Light X keyword that do not already have Ambrosia tokens on them. Those Ambrosia tokens still count toward your Ambrosia Limit. If a game element with Ambrosia tokens is discarded for any reason, move the Ambrosia tokens to your Titan Sheet. Disable Light X keywords on a game element with Ambrosia tokens on it.
traits.Psychosomatic Poisoning: Start of Battle: Place an Ambrosia token on the Condition deck. When you gain a Condition card, and each time you start your turn with a Condition card, gain 1 Ambrosia token.
traits.Argo's Parting Gift: Start of Battle: Place this card in the Wound Stack. Depending on Ur-Fleece's level, this card counts as: Level 2: 87 Wounds. Level 3: 86 Wounds. Level 4: 85 Wounds. Level 5: 84 Wounds. Level 6: 83 Wounds. Level 7: 82 Wounds. Level 8: 81 Wounds. Level 9: 80 Wounds.
traits.All for All: Reference. When you attack a BP III (and only a BP III), proceed to resolve it as a normal Attack, but after performing the Power Roll, divide your Total Power by 2 (rounding up), add +1 if you had a Crit Chance, and then note the result. Do not Escalate and do not resolve any responses. Instead, Ur-Fleece Flickers. Then, clear the Kratos Pool and continue to your second ability window. Finally, place the BP card on top of the BP deck. Note: This does not count as a Wound! The next two Titan attacks targeting this BP III will similarly add half of their Total Power to this growing Ultimate Power, following the above rules. The final, fourth Attack should be performed as a normal Attack, but add their full Total Power to this Ultimate Power. This means each subsequent Titan Attack is stronger than the last. If, during any of the four Attacks the Ultimate Power matches or beats the AT of the BP card, you finally deal a Wound! If any Titan attacks another BP card, erase the noted Power and ignore this effect. If you do not Wound the BP card with the fourth Attack in a row, do not note your Power, erase the noted Power and suffer the Fail or Instinct response instead! Important: During the White Lie Battle see paragraph 8677, on p. 70 for additional rules.
traits.Darkest Before Dawn: Each time Ur-Fleece gains a Wound (a Double Wound is treated as 2 Wounds), place a token on this Trait. After resolving the current action, if there are 4 or more tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens and spawn an additional Black Abyss tile on the leftmost spaces of the lane with the Black Abyss that Ur-Fleece is on. If this would cause the tile to overlap another tile, move that other tile as if it was affected by Black March.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Deeper Depths: Each Titan starts the Battle with 1 Oxygen token less.
traits.Contagious Fear: When a Titan gains a negative Condition card, each other Titan gains the same Condition.
traits.Unfathomable Depths: Each Titan starts the Battle with 2 Oxygen tokens less.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
